sloka: महेंद्रसद्मप्रतिमं तु वेश्म ।रामस्य रम्यं मृगमुच्चं ।विभ्राजमानं प्रभया सुमम्त्रः ॥२-१५-४५॥
transliteration: maheṁdrasadmapratimaṁ tu veśma ।rāmasya ramyaṁ mṛgamuccaṁ ।vibhrājamānaṁ prabhayā sumamtraḥ ॥2-15-45॥

translations.english: Sumantra beheld Rama's palace which resembled the high summit of mount Meru shining with splendour. Filled with animals and birds, if looked like the abode of Indra.
